annotations.title: Register a stream connector or series

description: Registers an inline connector or rotating-series document under document_name (a .json name). Send the canonical document object, never credential values; a named secret is enrolled in workspace settings. Returns stream_connector_document_id and server-derived document_digest; use that bare digest as connector_document_digest when starting work. A series uses the same admission route. Starts no network connection or recorder. Next: create_stream_registry with admitted digests. Reuse idempotency_key when reconciling registration; never invent a digest.
name: register_stream_document
title: Register a stream connector or series
